### SES AI Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


November 12, 2026


*Unveils Flywheel corporate structure, composed of three complementary businesses*


*Delivered third quarter revenue of $6.6 million, up 31% from the second quarter*


*Completed ramp of Chungju, South Korea line to 1 million NDAA-compliant drone cells per year; expansion to 3 million cells per year planned by the end of the second quarter of 2027*


*Narrowed GAAP net loss to $13.4 million from $17.9 million in the second quarter*


*Maintained liquidity of approximately $137 million with no debt*


*Reiterated full year 2026 revenue guidance of $30 million to $35 million*


**Highlights**


- Reported revenue of $6.6 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $5.1 million in the second quarter of 2026; product revenue more than doubled from $3.2 million in the third quarter of 2025.
- GAAP net loss in the third quarter of 2026 of $13.4 million, or $0.04 per share, compared to a GAAP net loss of $17.9 million, or $0.05 loss per share, in the second quarter of 2026
- Non-GAAP net loss in the third quarter of 2026 of $10.7 million, or $0.03 loss per share, compared to a non-GAAP net loss of $13.1 million, or $0.04 loss per share, in the second quarter of 2026
- Completed the ramp of the Chungju, South Korea drone cell line to an installed capacity of 1 million NDAA-compliant cells per year, with ISO 9001 certification; the line has been running since early October
- Announced a staged expansion of the Chungju line to 3 million NDAA-compliant cells per year, planned by the end of the second quarter of 2027
- Secured PO from multiple participants and winners of the Drone Dominance Program Gauntlet challenge, with more than 50 drone makers and pack integrators in the pipeline, with half a dozen line audits completed
- Molecular Universe 4.0, delivered through the M-Lab offering, is in evaluation with several of the world’s largest battery manufacturers
- Reiterated previously issued full year 2026 revenue guidance in a range of $30 million to $35 million


WOBURN, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


**SES AI Corporation** (“SES”) (NYSE: SES), a global developer and manufacturer of AI-enhanced high-performance Li-Metal and Li-ion batteries for drones and other unmanned systems, today announced its business results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and reiterated its previously issued financial guidance for the year ending December 31, 2026.


The Company posted a[Letter to Our Shareholders](https://investors.ses.ai/ShareholderLetter3Q26) on its Investor Relations website, which provides a business update, details on its third quarter 2026 results, and its guidance for 2026.


Dr. Qichao Hu, Founder and CEO of SES, said, “SES has reached a significant turning point. We have successfully delivered on the three commitments we made last quarter. We completed the ramp of our Chungju line to 1 million NDAA-compliant drone cells per year, our net loss narrowed by about 25%, and Molecular Universe 4.0 is now in evaluation with leading battery manufacturers. We see our business model as a Flywheel composed of three facets: Charge, Fly, and Discover. Energy storage (Charge) is our revenue base today, drone cells (Fly) scale next, and Molecular Universe (Discover) compounds over time.”


“Drones and unmanned systems are our central growth priority, and that is where our incremental capital is going,” added Dr. Hu. “We are busy producing and delivering cells to meet customer orders, so we are beginning a staged expansion toward capacity of 3 million cells per year. From here, our focus is execution and securing qualifications, orders, shipments and repeat customers.”

**About SES:**


SES AI Corp. (NYSE: SES) is powering the future of global electric transportation on land and in the air with the world’s most advanced Li-ion and Anode-Free Li-Metal batteries. SES AI is the first battery company in the world to accelerate its pace of innovation by utilizing superintelligent AI across the spectrum of its business, from research and development; materials sourcing; cell design; engineering and manufacturing; to battery health and safety monitoring. Founded in 2012, SES AI is an advanced Li-ion and Anode-Free Li-Metal battery developer and manufacturer headquartered in Boston and with NDAA-compliant manufacturing plant in Chungju, South Korea. Learn more at[SES.AI](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ses.ai%2F&esheet=54639663&newsitemid=20261112251293&lan=en-US&anchor=SES.AI&index=5&md5=3e0ea7e46fffe483da9a8c30a8d84ef1) .

**Non-GAAP Financial Measures**


This press release includes the use of non-GAAP financial measures, which are intended to provide supplemental information regarding our performance. These non-GAAP measures include Gross profit (Non-GAAP), Gross margin (Non-GAAP), Operating expenses (Non-GAAP), Loss from operations (Non-GAAP), EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA, Net loss (Non-GAAP) attributable to SES shareholders, and Earnings per share (Non-GAAP).


We use these non-GAAP measures to supplement our financial reporting and to evaluate ongoing operations and results, facilitate internal planning and forecasting, and assess performance against prior periods, industry peers, and the broader market. These non-GAAP measures are not prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) and should not be considered as an alternative to GAAP results. Industry peers and other companies may calculate similar non-GAAP measures differently. Non-GAAP financial measures have limitations, including that they exclude the impact of certain items that are included in the most directly comparable measure calculated and presented in accordance with GAAP, which adjustments reflect the exercise of judgment by management. We believe that these non-GAAP measures, when considered together with the GAAP results, provide investors with an additional understanding of our operating performance. Reconciliations of each non-GAAP financial measure to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure can be found in the supplemental non-GAAP information section at the end of this press release.


As presented in the “Reconciliation of Non-GAAP Financial Measures” tables below, each of the non-GAAP financial measures excludes the impact of one or more of the following items for purposes of calculating non-GAAP financial measures to facilitate an evaluation of SES’s current operating performance and a comparison to its past operating performance:


*Stock-based compensation expense* . SES excludes the impact of stock-based compensation expense from its non-GAAP measures primarily because they are non-cash in nature. Moreover, the impact of this expense is significantly affected by SES’s stock price at the time of an award, which can be volatile and over which management has limited to no control.


*Depreciation and amortization* . This item represents depreciation and amortization of purchased long-lived assets and acquired intangible assets, which are both non-cash expenses. Acquisition related amortization of acquired intangible assets are not reflective of SES’s ongoing financial performance.


*Interest income* . This item consists primarily of interest income on short term debt securities that primarily includes accretion income from the debt securities as they progress towards their maturity date.


*Benefit (provision) from income taxes* . This item represents the amount adjusted to SES’s GAAP tax provision or benefit to exclude the impact of the income tax effects of GAAP adjustments that are not reflective of SES’s ongoing financial performance.


*(Loss) gain on change in fair value of Sponsor Earn-Out Liability* . This item represents the amount adjusted to SES’s GAAP fair value liability for Sponsor Earn-Out shares, which is a non-cash adjustment that is more tied to the change in stock price rather than management’s operational performance.


***Definitions***


Gross profit (Non-GAAP), Gross margin (Non-GAAP), Operating expenses (Non-GAAP), and Loss from operations (Non-GAAP) represent, in each case, the corresponding GAAP financial measure adjusted to exclude the impact of stock-based compensation expense and depreciation and amortization.


EBITDA represents net loss attributable to SES shareholders adjusted to exclude the impact of interest income, taxes, depreciation and amortization.


Adjusted EBITDA represents EBITDA adjusted to exclude the impact of loss (gain) on change in fair value of Sponsor Earn-Out liability and stock-based compensation.


Net loss (Non-GAAP) attributable to SES shareholders represents Adjusted EBITDA adjusted further to reinclude the impact of interest income.


Earnings per share (Non-GAAP) represents earnings (loss) per share adjusted to exclude the impact of taxes, depreciation and amortization, loss (gain) on change in fair value of Sponsor Earn-Out liability and stock-based compensation.
